crop.notes: A long strip of sporting briefs (baseball, football rules, chess, athletics); only the first 'Sporting Notes' paragraph (crop-4) is about Allen.

ocr.notes: Allen notice reads '$15 heres street' for '619 Market street'; the baseball letters at the top are badly garbled.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a sporting note advertising Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, March 21, 1891, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised free concerts every evening with 'the best of singers only engaged'

notes: The same notice ran in many issues.
